items.evidence: Loop moves 40 uL beads to each of 96 samples with pip.mix(10, 60) after dispensing, followed by the 5 min incubation comment before the magnet comment.
Magnet engage/settle comment is recorded, then 90 uL goes from every well to waste, then two 200 uL ethanol add and 200 uL remove loops over all wells.
Comments record the 5 min air dry and magnet disengage, then 50 uL water is added with mix(10, 40), followed by the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage comment.
zip(samples, elutions) moves 45 uL from each sample well to the matching elution plate well; end_state:elution_plate passed.
move() picks up a new tip and drops it for every single transfer; the no_cross_contamination and tip checks passed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows every step of the bead cleanup. It uses a fresh tip for each well, and all measured checks passed.
